license_required.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice registered nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state unless the person has complied with the provisions of the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

issuing_authority.quote: The education, certification and licensure of registered and licensed practical nurses or advanced unlicensed assistive persons, and the practice of registered or practical nursing or advanced unlicensed assistance in this state is hereby declared to affect the public health, safety and welfare and, in the public interest, is therefore subject to regulation and control by the Oklahoma Board of Nursing.

exams.name: NCLEX-RN
exams.notes: Written examination required for RN licensure; applicant who fails subject to reexamination per Board rules

exams.name: NCLEX-PN

exams.quote: The applicant for a license to practice as a Licensed Practical Nurse shall be required to pass a written examination in such subjects as the Board may require.

exams.quote: who has passed a national certification examination recognized by the Board that measures the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse role and specialty competencies and who maintains recertification in the role and specialty through a national certification program

interval_years.quote: a license or certificate shall be renewed every two (2) years according to a schedule published by the Oklahoma Board of Nursing

renewal_fee_usd.quote: no single fee for an initial application for licensure or certification, or for renewal, reinstatement or return to active practice shall exceed One Hundred Twenty-five Dollars ($125.00)

required.quote: At the time of application renewal, a Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist shall submit documentation of a minimum of eight (8) units of continuing education, completed during the previous two (2) years, in advanced pharmacology relating to the administration of anesthesia

hours_per_period.quote: submit documentation of a minimum of eight (8) units of continuing education, completed during the previous two (2) years, in advanced pharmacology relating to the administration of anesthesia

period_years.quote: a minimum of eight (8) units of continuing education, completed during the previous two (2) years

value: advanced pharmacology relating to the administration of anesthesia (CRNA renewal)
pharmacotherapeutics, clinical application, and use of pharmacological agents (APRN prescriptive authority renewal)
two (2) hours of education in pain management or two (2) hours of education in opioid use or addiction (APRN prescriptive authority renewal)
topical_requirements.quote: documentation of a minimum of: fifteen (15) contact hours or one (1) academic credit hour of education in pharmacotherapeutics, clinical application, and use of pharmacological agents in the prevention of illness, and in the restoration and maintenance of health...and two (2) hours of education in pain management or two (2) hours of education in opioid use or addiction

available.quote: The Board may issue a license to practice nursing as a registered nurse without examination to an applicant who has been duly licensed as a Registered Nurse under the laws of another state, territory, the District of Columbia or a foreign country, if such applicant meets the qualifications required for licensing as a Registered Nurse in this state.

requirements.value: Applicant must meet the qualifications required for licensing as a Registered Nurse in Oklahoma. For APRN, must hold recognition as an APRN in another state, hold current RN license in Oklahoma, meet continued competency requirements, and satisfy other Board requirements.
requirements.quote: The Board may issue a license by endorsement to an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse licensed under the laws of another state if the applicant meets the qualifications for licensure in this state.

exists.quote: subject to regulation and control by the Oklahoma Board of Nursing

national_certification.quote: certified by the National Board of Certification and Recertification for Nurse Anesthetists as a Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist within one (1) year following completion of an approved Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist education program

national_association.quote: possesses evidence of certification according to the requirements of the American College of Nurse-Midwives

credential_type.quote: Upon an applicant successfully passing such an examination, the Board may issue to the applicant a license to practice as a Registered Nurse.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice registered nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state unless the person has complied with the provisions of the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

title_protection.quote: Any person who holds a license to practice as a registered nurse in this state shall have the right to use both the title "Registered Nurse" and the abbreviation "R.N." No other person shall assume such title or use such abbreviation, or any other words, letters, signs or figures to indicate that the person using the same is a registered nurse.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice registered nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state unless the person has complied with the provisions of the Oklahoma Nursing Practice Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Deceit or material misrepresentation in procuring or attempting to procure a license or certification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of deceit or material misrepresentation in procuring or attempting to procure: a license to practice registered nursing, licensed practical nursing, or a license to practice advanced practice registered nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions or duties of a licensee, or any offense involving fraud, dishonesty, or an act of violence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of a felony, or any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any licensee or Advanced Unlicensed Assistant, or any offense an essential element of which is fraud, dishonesty, or an act of violence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately care for patients or conform to minimum standards of acceptable nursing practice, unnecessarily exposing a patient to risk of harm
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to adequately care for patients or to conform to the minimum standards of acceptable nursing or Advanced Unlicensed Assistant practice that, in the opinion of the Board, unnecessarily exposes a patient or other person to risk of harm

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intemperate use of alcohol or drugs that endangers or could endanger patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is intemperate in the use of alcohol or drugs, which use the Board determines endangers or could endanger patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pattern of practice or behavior demonstrating actual or potential inability to practice nursing with sufficient knowledge or reasonable skills and safety due to impairment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exhibits through a pattern of practice or other behavior actual or potential inability to practice nursing with sufficient knowledge or reasonable skills and safety due to impairment caused by illness, use of alcohol, drugs, chemicals or any other substance, or as a result of any mental or physical condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent or dangerous to the public, or commitment by a court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been adjudicated as mentally incompetent, mentally ill, chemically dependent or dangerous to the public or has been committed by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined in the rules of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined in the rules of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act that jeopardizes a patient's life, health or safety as defined in the rules of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is guilty of any act that jeopardizes a patient's life, health or safety as defined in the rules of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a Board rule, Board order, or state or federal law relating to nursing practice or narcotics/controlled dangerous substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated a rule promulgated by the Board, an order of the Board, or a state or federal law relating to the practice of registered, practical or advanced practice registered nursing or advanced unlicensed assisting, or a state or federal narcotics or controlled dangerous substance law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary actions taken against the individual's nursing license or any professional or occupational license in any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had disciplinary actions taken against the individual's registered or practical nursing license, advanced unlicensed assistive certification, or any professional or occupational license, registration or certification in this or any state, territory or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Default or termination from the peer assistance program for any reason
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has defaulted or been terminated from the peer assistance program for any reason

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain professional boundaries with patients as defined in Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to maintain professional boundaries with patients, as defined in the Board rules

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual misconduct with a current or former patient or key party as defined in Board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in sexual misconduct, as defined in Board rules, with a current or former patient or key party, inside or outside the health care setting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly providing gender transition procedures to a child
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly provided gender transition procedures as defined in Section 1 of this act to a child.

insurance_required.quote: An Advanced Practice Registered Nurse, or the employer of the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse on his or her behalf, shall carry malpractice insurance or demonstrate proof of financial responsibility in a minimum amount of One Million Dollars ($1,000,000.00) per occurrence and Three Million Dollars ($3,000,000.00) in the aggregate per year.

definition_quote.value: The practice of nursing means the performance of services provided for purposes of nursing diagnosis and treatment of human responses to actual or potential health problems consistent with educational preparation.
definition_quote.quote: "The practice of nursing" means the performance of services provided for purposes of nursing diagnosis and treatment of human responses to actual or potential health problems consistent with educational preparation.

value: assessing the health status of individuals, families, and groups
analyzing assessment data to determine nursing care needs
establishing goals to meet identified health care needs
delegating tasks as may safely be performed by others
providing safe and effective nursing care rendered directly or indirectly
teaching the principles and practice of nursing
managing and supervising the practice of nursing
collaborating with other health professionals in the management of health care
performing additional nursing functions in accordance with knowledge and skills acquired beyond basic nursing preparation
execution of the medical regime including the administration of medications and treatments prescribed by any person authorized by state law to so prescribe
methods_authorized.quote: "Registered nursing" means the practice of the full scope of nursing which includes, but is not limited to: assessing the health status of individuals, families, and groups, analyzing assessment data to determine nursing care needs, establishing goals to meet identified health care needs, planning a strategy of care, establishing priorities of nursing intervention to implement the strategy of care, implementing the strategy of care, delegating such tasks as may safely be performed by others

drug_authority.value: APRNs (CNP, CNS, CNM) may obtain prescriptive authority recognition from the Board; CRNAs in collaboration with a physician may order, select, obtain, and administer legend drugs, Schedules II through V controlled substances, devices, and medical gases during perioperative/periobstetrical periods
drug_authority.quote: A Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist, in collaboration with a medical doctor, osteopathic physician, podiatric physician, or dentist licensed in this state...shall be authorized...to order, select, obtain, and administer legend drugs, Schedules II through V controlled substances, devices, and medical gases only when engaged in the preanesthetic preparation and evaluation; anesthesia induction, maintenance, and emergence; and postanesthesia care.

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Certified Nurse-Midwife (CNM)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS)
Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - Certified Nurse Practitioner (CNP)
license_tiers.quote: Only those persons who have obtained a license in the following disciplines shall have the right to fulfill the roles and use the applicable titles: Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist and the abbreviation "CRNA", Certified Nurse-Midwife and the abbreviation "CNM", Clinical Nurse Specialist and the abbreviation "CNS", and Certified Nurse Practitioner and the abbreviation "CNP".

aprn_role_categories.quote: who has obtained a license as an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse in one of the following roles: Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist, Certified Nurse-Midwife, Clinical Nurse Specialist, or Certified Nurse Practitioner.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "Licensed practical nursing" means the practice of nursing under the supervision or direction of a Registered Nurse, licensed physician, or dentist.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: Define the procedure for documenting supervision by a supervising physician...of a Certified Nurse Practitioner, Clinical Nurse Specialist, or Certified Nurse-Midwife who has not obtained independent prescriptive authority under Section 1 of this act. Such procedure shall include a written supervision agreement

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An Advanced Practice Registered Nurse recognized by the Oklahoma Board of Nursing as a Certified Nurse Practitioner, Clinical Nurse Specialist, or Certified Nurse-Midwife who has completed a minimum of six thousand two hundred forty (6,240) clinical practice hours with prescriptive authority supervised by a physician may apply to the Oklahoma Board of Nursing for authority to prescribe and order independent of supervision.

full_independent_practice_experience_hou.quote: has completed a minimum of six thousand two hundred forty (6,240) clinical practice hours with prescriptive authority supervised by a physician may apply to the Oklahoma Board of Nursing for authority to prescribe and order independent of supervision.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: The Oklahoma Board of Nursing may grant prescriptive authority through the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse license to Certified Nurse Practitioners, Clinical Nurse Specialists, and Certified Nurse-Midwives who meet the requirements for prescriptive authority identified by law and in the Board's rules.

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: shall be authorized...to order, select, obtain, and administer legend drugs, Schedules II through V controlled substances, devices, and medical gases only when engaged in the preanesthetic preparation and evaluation; anesthesia induction, maintenance, and emergence; and postanesthesia care.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: APRNs may not prescribe opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes; violation is a disciplinary ground
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: delegating those nursing tasks as defined in the rules of the Board that may be performed by an Advanced Unlicensed Assistant

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical/vocational nursing issued by a home state to a resident in that state will be recognized by each party state as authorizing a nurse to practice as a registered nurse (RN) or as a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN), under a multistate licensure privilege, in each party state.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: The application fee for a multistate license issued pursuant to Section 5 of this act shall be One Hundred Fifty Dollars ($150.00). The biennial multistate license renewal fee shall be One Hundred Twenty-five Dollars ($125.00)

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: There is hereby established a peer assistance program to rehabilitate nurses whose competency may be compromised because of the abuse of drugs or alcohol, so that such nurses can be treated and can return to or continue the practice of nursing in a manner which will benefit the public.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: who has completed a minimum of six thousand two hundred forty (6,240) clinical practice hours with prescriptive authority supervised by a physician may apply to the Oklahoma Board of Nursing for authority to prescribe and order independent of supervision.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: administers anesthesia in collaboration with a medical doctor, an osteopathic physician, a podiatric physician, or a dentist licensed in this state and under conditions in which timely on-site consultation by such doctor, osteopath, podiatric physician, or dentist is available.

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: Establish a Formulary Advisory Council that shall develop and submit to the Board recommendations for an exclusionary formulary that shall list drugs or categories of drugs that shall not be prescribed by an Advanced Practice Registered Nurse recognized to prescribe by the Oklahoma Board of Nursing.

military_education_credit_required.quote: the Oklahoma Board of Nursing shall develop program guidelines for Board-approved nursing education programs to utilize in transitioning veterans with prior military medical training and experience into nursing education programs.
